device_label: ITO plasmonic taper EAM, gap 340 nm, LT = 3.1 um (design)
il_onchip_includes: back-to-back tapers and MIM section between the Si-waveguide ports (TM0 to TM0)
epitaxy_or_stack: Si waveguide 300 nm x 500 nm planarized in SiO2 / MIM stacks on both sides: 30 nm Al / 3.6 nm Al2O3 / 20 nm ITO (bulk 2.65e20 cm^-3) / 50 nm Au; FIB-milled gap g with 20 nm over-mill into Si; taper gap 520 nm to gmin; W_slab 175 nm (Fig. 1(b))
notes: Design study, all simulated (COMSOL 2D modes, 3D beam envelope). Two tapers of length LT each, so active length = 2 x LT (derived; consistent with the Eq. 12 bandwidth for the RC estimate). ER is the maximum over gate voltage of 10 log(Pon/Poff), Pon at -3 V, Poff at the stated Vg (SPC model). IL_total is at flat band: Sec. 4.2 for 340 nm; Table 1 matches the Fig. 9 flat-band TM0 transmittance for all three gaps (figure reading). Bandwidth is the lumped RC estimate (Eq. 12; 8.1 fF/um, 3.35 ohm um parasitic series resistance, 50 ohm source and load), not an EO response. Gate-voltage swing -3 V to the stated Vg is not an RF drive amplitude. Platform plasmonic_mim = the coupled MIM modulating section; the Si access strip sits in SiO2 (Fig. 1(b)), SOI not stated. Electrode lumped per p.15 (~6 um). SPC maximum ER 25.7 dB at 2.8 V (Table 1; abstract/conclusion round to 26 dB, 125 GHz, 6 dB); CDD model: 6.8 dB at 2.0 V. Taper length LT = 3.1 um maximizes TM0-to-TM0 transmittance (0.229) at flat band (Sec. 4.2).
